title: Continuity of a supplied fixed-base cohomology cocone
statement: Let J be a small nonempty cofiltered category, D:J→Sch a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], π:D→const S, c a limit cone, and t:c.pt→S such that t=c_j π_j for all j. For an abelian etale sheaf G on S [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and q≥0, suppose H:Jᵒᵖ→Ab has stage isomorphisms H(j)≅H^q(π_j⁻¹G) and maps given by the triangle pullbacks of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-triangle-laws]. Suppose B is a cocone for H and e:B.pt≅H^q(t⁻¹G), whose legs followed by e are the stage isomorphisms followed by the triangle pullbacks along c_j. Then B is a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: Choose the directed final functor to J opposite, and whisker c along its initial left opposite. This gives the same limit, with qcqs stages and affine transitions.

Use inverse upperStarComp for the stage sheaf transitions. Unit and associativity coherence verify the sheaf-system equations. Use the constant diagram with value t inverse image G on the limit; upperStarComp identifies its objects with the pulled-back stage sheaves and associativity verifies its transition equations.
The identity cocone on the constant limit-sheaf diagram is a colimit since the directed category is connected.

The given hH and hB give exactly the canonical comparison equations of nonempty_isColimit_etale_cohomology_of_isLimit. Apply that theorem to the reindexed data. Transfer its universal property back with Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_isColimit_cofiltered_fixed_base_cohomology {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] {S : Scheme.{u}} (D : J ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (π : D ⟶ (Functor.const J).obj S) [∀ j, CompactSpace (D.obj j)] [∀ j, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj j)] [∀ {j k : J} (f : j ⟶ k), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (t : c.pt ⟶ S) (ht : ∀ j : J, t = c.π.app j ≫ π.app j) (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (H : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (eH : ∀ j : J, H.obj (op j) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (((π.app j)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj G) q)) (hH : ∀ (j k : J) (f : j ⟶ k), H.map f.op = (eH k).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyTriangleMap (D.map f) (π.app k) (π.app j) (by have h := (π.naturality f).symm change π.app j ≫ 𝟙 S = D.map f ≫ π.app k at h exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans h) G q) ≫ (eH j).inv) (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (((t)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj G) q)) (hB : ∀ j : J, B.ι.app (op j) ≫ eB.hom = (eH j).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyTriangleMap (c.π.app j) (π.app j) t (ht j) G q)) : Nonempty (IsColimit B)
